seoTitle: Scrubs Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Scrubs test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're J.D., Turk, Elliot, Carla, Dr. Cox, Dr. Kelso, the Janitor or Ted — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the daydreamer, the grumpy mentor, or the one plotting revenge with a mop? Answer 12 everyday questions about work, friends and bad days, and find out which Scrubs character you are.

characters.name: J.D.
characters.title: The Daydreamer
characters.summary: Sweet, sensitive and lost in your own head. You feel everything, and you'd really like someone to tell you you're doing great.
description: Like J.D., you live half in your imagination. He narrates the show, and he's always drifting off into wild daydreams.
You want a mentor's approval more than anything. J.D. looks up to Dr. Cox, who calls him 'Newbie' or a girl's name instead of his real one.
You're a big softie. Carla calls J.D. 'Bambi', and his best friend Turk shares custody of a stuffed dog called Rowdy with him.
characters.flaw: You overthink everything, especially things that haven't happened yet.
characters.signature: A daydream mid-conversation, a best friend on speed dial and a stuffed dog called Rowdy.
characters.clashReason: they'd need you to tell them they did a good job, every single day

characters.name: Turk
characters.title: The Cool Best Friend
characters.summary: Confident, funny and loyal to the end. You take your work seriously and yourself not at all.
description: Like Turk, you're good at what you do, and you know it. He's a surgeon at Sacred Heart, and he works his way up to chief of surgery.
You're the best friend everyone wants. Turk and J.D. have been inseparable since college, and J.D. is his best man.
You're a family man at heart. Turk marries Carla, and they have a daughter, Izzy.
characters.flaw: You're so relaxed that you sometimes miss when things are actually serious.
characters.signature: A pair of scrubs, a big grin and a best friend who's basically family.
characters.clashReason: they'd laugh it off when you wanted them to take it seriously

characters.name: Elliot Reid
characters.title: The Neurotic Overachiever
characters.summary: Smart, driven and wonderfully awkward. You work harder than anyone, and worry harder too.
description: Like Elliot, you're desperate to prove yourself. She comes from a wealthy family, and she works incredibly hard to be taken seriously as a doctor.
You get flustered. When Elliot is stressed or ignored, her voice gets higher and higher.
You make your own way. Elliot has a difficult relationship with her mother, and she goes on to run her own private practice.
characters.flaw: You say exactly the wrong thing at exactly the wrong moment, then keep talking.
characters.signature: A colour-coded study plan, an awkward laugh and a voice that goes up an octave under pressure.
characters.clashReason: they'd panic out loud about things you hadn't even thought to worry about

characters.name: Carla Espinosa
characters.title: The Mother Hen
characters.summary: Caring, fierce and in charge. You look after everyone, and you know everybody's business.
description: Like Carla, you look after people. She's the head nurse at Sacred Heart, and she's a mother figure to the young doctors.
You cover for the people you love. Carla often fixes the interns' mistakes before anyone else notices them.
You give everyone a nickname. Carla calls J.D. 'Bambi', and she marries his best friend, Turk.
characters.flaw: You can't stay out of other people's business, even when they ask you to.
characters.signature: A clipboard, a stern look and a nickname for everyone you love.
characters.clashReason: they'd fix your life for you, whether you asked them to or not

characters.name: Dr. Cox
characters.title: The Grumpy Mentor
characters.summary: Brilliant, sarcastic and secretly soft. You'd rather give a ten-minute rant than admit you care.
description: Like Dr. Cox, you're famous for your rants. He's a brilliant, bitter senior doctor who can tear anyone apart with words.
You care more than you let on. Dr. Cox is J.D.'s mentor, but he'd never admit it, and he calls him 'Newbie' or a girl's name instead.
You work out your feelings on your own. Dr. Cox plays basketball alone in the parking lot, and he eventually becomes chief of medicine.
characters.flaw: You'd rather push people away than let them see you care.
characters.signature: A basketball, a ten-minute rant and a nickname you'll never live down.
characters.clashReason: they'd tear your idea apart in a five-minute speech, then help you fix it

characters.name: Dr. Kelso
characters.title: The Bottom-Line Boss
characters.summary: Calm, practical and very hard to impress. You run things your way, and you don't lose sleep over it.
description: Like Dr. Kelso, you're all about the bottom line. He's Sacred Heart's chief of medicine for most of the show, and money always comes first.
You keep your soft side well hidden. Kelso is cold and blunt most of the time, but there are hints that he cares more than he shows.
You stay in the game. Kelso retires, then comes back to the hospital as a professor.
characters.flaw: You'd cut almost anything if it saved a bit of money.
characters.signature: A budget sheet, a firm handshake and a pat on the shoulder that means 'no'.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn down your big idea because it costs too much

characters.name: The Janitor
characters.title: The Prankster
characters.summary: Mysterious, mischievous and impossible to read. You hold a grudge, and you have a lot of free time.
description: Like the Janitor, you never forget a slight. He decided early on that J.D. was his enemy, and he's been pranking him ever since.
You have your own little crew. The Janitor runs the Brain Trust, a group of hospital staff who spend their time scheming.
Nobody really knows who you are. The Janitor's own name is a mystery for most of the show, and he tells so many stories that nobody can tell which are true.
characters.flaw: Once someone's on your list, there's no getting off it.
characters.signature: A mop, a grudge and a story that may or may not be true.
characters.clashReason: they'd decide you were their enemy over something tiny, and mean it

characters.name: Ted Buckland
characters.title: The Sad Sack
characters.summary: Nervous, gloomy and quietly lovable. Things never seem to go your way, but you keep showing up.
description: Like Ted, you expect the worst. He's the hospital's lawyer, and he has never won a case.
You do whatever the boss says. Ted spends most of the show being bossed around by Dr. Kelso.
You've got a hidden talent. Ted leads the Worthless Peons, the hospital's a cappella group, and he finally finds love with Stephanie Gooch.
characters.flaw: You give up before you've even started.
characters.signature: A briefcase, a nervous sweat and a four-part harmony.
characters.clashReason: they'd find the bad side of every good news story you told them

questions.text: It's your first day at a new job. You...

options.text: Daydream about how great you'll be, and miss half the instructions
Know everyone's name, and most of their business, by lunch
Over-prepare, then say something weird to your new boss
Keep your head down and hope nobody notices you

questions.text: A coworker asks you for advice. You...

options.text: Give it to them straight, in a ten-minute rant they didn't ask for
Tell them what they want to hear. Arguing isn't worth it
Make up some terrible advice, just to see what happens
Hug them, then deliver a long, heartfelt speech
Hanging out with your best friend, doing absolutely nothing
Shooting hoops on your own, with nobody trying to talk to you
A long lunch somewhere nice, on someone else's money
Building something strange in the garage that nobody's allowed to see

questions.text: Someone at work keeps getting on your nerves. You...

options.text: Make their life a tiny bit worse every day, for as long as it takes
Give them a nickname they'll never shake off
Laugh it off. Life's too short
Have a quiet word with them. Then a less quiet one

questions.text: You've made a mistake at work that could get you in trouble. You...

options.text: Admit it straight away, then apologise far too many times
Picture the worst thing that could happen, in vivid detail
Make sure the paperwork shows it wasn't your fault
Panic, and assume you'll get the blame either way

questions.text: Your friends want to throw you a surprise party. You...

options.text: Ask them not to. You hate being the centre of attention
Act grumpy about the whole thing, then enjoy every second
Turn up in your best outfit and own the dance floor
Help plan it yourself. You don't trust anyone else to get it right

questions.text: Your boss offers you a raise if you take on the jobs nobody else wants. You...

options.text: Take the money, then quietly find ways to skip the jobs
Say yes before they've finished the sentence. You'd love them to be proud of you
Negotiate hard. They clearly need you more than you need them
Turn it down. Your free time is worth more than that

questions.text: Your friend has just been through a bad breakup. You...

options.text: Bring snacks and let them cry on your shoulder all night
Try to cheer them up, and somehow end up talking about yourself
Turn up with ice cream and a sad film, and cry more than they do
Send a text. Feelings aren't really your area

questions.text: Someone tells you a story that sounds totally made up. You...

options.text: Tell an even bigger one back, and swear it's true
Believe it, then start worrying about what it means for you
Fact-check it on your phone while they're still talking
Nod, smile and stop listening

questions.text: You're put in charge of training the new person at work. You...

options.text: Go hard on them. They'll thank you for it one day
Look after them like they're your own kid
Give them all the jobs you hate doing
Try a bit too hard to be the cool, fun mentor

questions.text: You work at a busy hospital that's short of money, and your boss tells you to cut corners. You...

options.text: Refuse, and tell your boss exactly what they can do with the budget
Agree, then feel terrible about it all night
Make the cuts. Somebody has to keep the lights on
Quietly find a way round it so nobody gets hurt

questions.text: You've just finished a brutal 30-hour shift at the hospital. You...

options.text: Head straight home. Family time beats everything
Feel so proud you need to tell someone, anyone, about your day
Stay a bit longer to make sure everyone else is okay
Cry in the car, then call your mum and regret it
